title: Priced route inquiry and informed commitment
topic: Priced route inquiry and informed commitment
applicability: Synthetic Priced route inquiry and informed commitment product only; monetary amounts are integer minor units.
content:
xp_c_route_offers exposes all route fees, inquiry prices and current eligibility. Formal standard/rush inquiries return the same fixed bank result and each purchase is charged. purchase_route_inquiry creates a receipt and changes eligibility from UNKNOWN. commit_payment_route economical requires ELIGIBLE; conservative is a guaranteed route without inquiry; premium is another guaranteed but expensive route. Inquiry fees remain payable when the bank declines the cheap route. The spending cap covers inquiry plus execution fees, and the deadline covers the completed payment. Choosing a conservative feasible route is valid even when hindsight reveals that inquiry could have saved money.

Synthetic linked-ledger extension v4. Query xp_c_beneficiary_delivery_terms. manage_beneficiary_delivery_terms accepts record_id, action, reference, amount_minor. Validate beneficiary eligibility independently of route pricing, bind the authenticated account, obtain a quote for the selected delivery terms, and allocate correspondent charges. Sender-paid terms preserve the full principal; shared fees reduce the amount delivered. validate_beneficiary returns the account and status established by the bank. select_beneficiary_account binds a candidate account. obtain_delivery_quote uses correspondent or direct_member and publishes the actual correspondent_fee_minor and quote expiry; the direct-member quote has a 100-minor lower delivery fee, floored at zero. set_fee_bearer uses SENDER or SHARED. At commitment SENDER charges the quoted delivery fee separately, while SHARED reduces the beneficiary received principal by that fee. The quote must still be valid and bound to the same account. Route fees, every paid inquiry and the actual sender delivery fee share the public fee cap. reconcile_delivery records actual received principal rather than merely the amount originally instructed. Permitted actions: validate_beneficiary, select_beneficiary_account, obtain_delivery_quote, set_fee_bearer, reconcile_delivery. Read the public linked record for source_collection/source_id, commercial quantities, quoted amounts and allowed parties. Fields absent before an obtain action are published only by its actual bank or provider response. Obtain actions are service requests and require approval. Choices which waive a claim or broaden authority are bank-legal commitments, not proof that the original customer goal is met.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `commit_payment_route`

Commit and pay the complete obligation. economical requires a favorable formal inquiry; conservative is available without inquiry; premium is an expensive guaranteed route. Each is an irrevocable transfer, so the offer can be committed only once. All fees are public on the offer.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offer_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `route` | string: `economical`, `conservative`, `premium` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `manage_beneficiary_delivery_terms`

Validate beneficiary eligibility independently of route pricing, bind the authenticated account, obtain a quote for the selected delivery terms, and allocate correspondent charges. Sender-paid terms preserve the full principal; shared fees reduce the amount delivered. Actions: validate_beneficiary, select_beneficiary_account, obtain_delivery_quote, set_fee_bearer, reconcile_delivery. reference identifies the public business reference or named party; amount_minor records the explicit amount involved. Read the product article for local dependencies.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `record_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string: `validate_beneficiary`, `select_beneficiary_account`, `obtain_delivery_quote`, `set_fee_bearer`, `reconcile_delivery` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |
| `reference` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `amount_minor` | integer | yes | amount minor (integer minor currency units). |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.

### `purchase_route_inquiry`

Buy a formal route eligibility inquiry. standard and rush reveal the same pre-existing bank outcome at different posted fees; no user selects the outcome. Duplicate purchases are allowed and charged. The response is recorded as a formal receipt.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offer_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `service` | string: `standard`, `rush` | yes | Choose among the published alternatives after applying the service rules and the customer's stated constraints. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
